title: Do You See the Waving Cape
description:
On my 7th birthday, my grandma presented me with a hand-knitted cape. As I put it on and looked in the mirror, a spark was ignited within me I knew that I wanted to become a hero. And thus began my great adventure.I embarked on this journey full of hope and wonder, but I soon realized that life can be frustrating and the gap between my expectation and reality was vast. But there was one constant that I could always count on - the love of my family. It was like a cape that blew in the wind behind me, guiding me through the toughest times.

This experience has been the inspiration for this game, which is like chatting with a new friend. In the form of a game, we will together go back to our childhood, searching for precious memories. The game will feature different gameplay styles like lonely flying, fierce battle, nerve-wracking parkour, as well as various kinds of puzzles. It will be an emotional journey about love, dreams, courage and even silly memories, that I hope will inspire you as much as it did me

• Special narrative style

• Different types of gameplay in one game

• Unique hand-drawn style graphic and beautiful background music
description_short: A point&click indie game with a very special narrative style. This game is inspired by the author's childhood and tells a story about Love, Growth, Dreams, and Reality. It integrates different types of gameplay into sentimental and interesting stories.
